# The Nomad HQ

> Data-driven guides and rankings that help remote workers and digital nomads decide where to live and work. Built on an index of 710 cities, each scored 0-10 across 13 categories (climate, cost of living, WiFi, safety, nightlife, nature, food, nomad community, English, visa ease, culture, cleanliness, air quality) that roll up into a composite Nomad Score.

The Nomad HQ (https://thenomadhq.com) publishes in-depth city guides, "best cities for X" rankings, and free interactive tools for location-independent workers. City guides include real cost-of-living data (sourced from Numbeo, shown in USD), neighborhoods, coworking spaces, visa notes, weather, and a 13-category score breakdown. Content is editorial and independent; the Nomad Score is derived from data and is never influenced by affiliate programs. Some outbound links (accommodation, insurance, eSIMs) are affiliate links, disclosed on the site. Operated by Topblog LLC; editorial by Yannick Schroth.

## Start here
- [All cities (browse & filter)](https://thenomadhq.com/cities): filterable index of every city by score, monthly budget, region, and climate.
- [Rankings hub](https://thenomadhq.com/best): all "best cities for X" lists.
- [Compare cities](https://thenomadhq.com/compare): side-by-side comparison of 2-3 cities across the Nomad Score, budget, and all 13 categories.
- [Interactive world map](https://thenomadhq.com/map): every city plotted, with scores.
- [Services by language](https://thenomadhq.com/services): 3096 local providers across 287 cities, indexed by the language they work in. Every language claim names the source it was read on. Each city has its own page, e.g. [Barcelona](https://thenomadhq.com/services/barcelona), each service in a city its own too, e.g. [German-speaking doctors in Barcelona](https://thenomadhq.com/services/barcelona/doctors), and each service across cities, e.g. [dentists](https://thenomadhq.com/services/dentists).

## Free tools
- [Nomad Taste Wheel](https://thenomadhq.com/wheel): matches you to cities by weighting your own preferences.
- [Geoarbitrage calculator](https://thenomadhq.com/geoarbitrage): how far your income stretches in each city.
- [Route planner](https://thenomadhq.com/route): plan a multi-city nomad route.
- [Time-zone finder](https://thenomadhq.com/timezones): overlap of working hours across cities.
- [Best weather by month](https://thenomadhq.com/best-weather): where to be for good weather any month.
- [Visa finder](https://thenomadhq.com/visa): filter cities by visa options for nomads.
- [Tier list maker](https://thenomadhq.com/tier-list/maker): build and share your own city tier list.
